notes.title: 🎮 PLAYTEST BEGINS! 🎮
notes.notes: [p]🎮 [b]PLAYTEST BEGINS![/b] 🎮[/p][p]Hey everyone! Today marks the start of the long-awaited playtest for [b]Your Story: Games with Death[/b]![/p][p]📋 [b]What's Available:[/b][/p][list][*][p]✅ All alternative stories for the female character[/p][/*][*][p]❌ Main story for the male character (not available yet)[/p][/*][/list][p]🎬 [b]Content & Streaming:[/b] You're free to share any content you create from the game anywhere you want! Stream it, make videos, post screenshots - we're all for it![/p][p]⚠️ [b]IMPORTANT REMINDER:[/b] The game is still in active development, and a lot can still change significantly. So please:[/p][list][*][p]Don't make premature ratings/reviews[/p][/*][*][p]Don't draw final conclusions about the gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Treat this as part of the development process[/p][/*][/list][p]🐛 [b]Found a bug or a feature that doesn't work as expected?[/b] Please report it to us in our Discord channel![/p][p]Enjoy the game and thank you for helping us make it better! 🖤[/p]
